questions.question: Which of the following options gives the correct sequence of events during mitosis?
options: Condensation $$ \to $$   Nuclear membrane disassembly $$ \to $$ Arrangement at equator $$ \to $$ Centromere division $$ \to $$ Segregation $$ \to $$ Telophase

questions.explanation:
(a) The correct sequence of events occur
during mitosis would be as follows

(i) DNA condensation occurs so that
chromosomes become visible during early to
mid-prophase.

(ii) Disassembly of nuclear membrane begins

move to opposite poles.

two daughter nuclei.

questions.question:
Good vishion depends on adequate intake of carotene rich food.

Select the best option from the following statements.
(1)  Vitamins A derivatives are formed from carotene,
(2)  The photopigments are embedded in the membrane discs of the inner segment.
(3)  Retinal is a derivative of vitamin A.
(4)  Retinal is a light absorbing part of all the visual photopigments.
questions.explanation:

questions.question: Thalassemia and sickle cell anemia are caused due to a problem in globin molecule synthesis. Select the correct statement.
options: Both are due to a qualitative defect in globin chain synthesis
Thalassemia is due to less synthesis of globin molecules
Sickle cell anemia is due to a quantitative problem of globin molecules
Both are due to a quantitative defect in globin chain synthesis
questions.explanation:
Sickle cell anaemia is caused due to point
mutation in which at the 6<sup>th</sup> position of beta globin
chain, glutamic acid is replaced by valine. Thus, it is a
qualitative defect in functioning of globin molecules.
Thalassemia is caused due to either mutation or
deletion which ultimately results in reduced rate of
synthesis of one of the globin chains that make up
haemoglobin. Hence, it is a quantitative defect in
functioning of globin molecules.

 is attached over the linker DNA.

and DNA.

Centre of gravity of a body is the point at
